text:
Residents:
Ines (70s, retired): Home most of the day. Morning walk, afternoon errands. Hobbies: friends, music, houseplants.
Yuki (70s, retired): Home most of the day. Morning walk, afternoon errands. Hobbies: meditation, movies, houseplants. Cares for the dog.
Hana (40s, WFH): At home desk 9:00–17:30. Sometimes out for lunch. Hobbies: movies, snacking.

Object Locations & Routines:
Bathroom:
- Shelf: Yuki’s glasses, Ines’ hair dryer, shared laundry basket, Ines’ skincare, Hana’s toiletry bag.
- Med Cabinet: Shared first aid kit, Hana’s and Yuki’s medication.
- Sink: Hana’s and Yuki’s razors, shared soap dispenser, shared toothbrush holder.
- Towel Rack: Individual towels for Hana, Ines, Yuki.

Bedroom 1 (Ines/Yuki):
- Floor: Yuki’s meditation cushion.
- Desk: Ines’ headphones/notebook/pen, Yuki’s notebook.
- Dresser: Ines’ hat, Yuki’s tablet.
- Nightstand: Ines’ book/wallet, Yuki’s book/phone.
- Wardrobe: Ines’ jacket.

Bedroom 2 (Hana):
- Nightstand: Hana’s book/tablet.

Entry:
- Hook: Shared dog leash, Hana’s hat/jacket/scarf, Yuki’s jacket/scarf.
- Table: Keys, sunglasses, wallets for all three residents.
- Shoe Rack: Shoes for all three residents.
- Floor: Shared doormat.

Kitchen:
- Counter: Shared cutting board, kettle, plant pot 2, toaster, wall clock. Ines’ and Yuki’s plates.
- Cupboard: Bowls/glasses/mugs for residents, shared pan/pot/serving dish/snack bowl/watering can.
- Dish Rack: Ines’ and Yuki’s water bottles.
- Drawer: Shared knife, spatula.
- Floor: Shared dog bowl.
- Table: Shared fruit bowl, Ines’ glass.
- Pantry: Shared dog food bag, shopping bag.
- Sink: Hana’s plate.

Living:
- Armchair: Shared cushion 2.
- Bookshelf: Shared picture frame, puzzle box, speaker, vase.
- Coffee Table: Shared candle, tissue box. Hana’s and Ines’ magazines.
- Couch: Shared blanket, cushion 1.
- Floor: Shared dog toy.
- Side Table: Shared lamp, plant pot 1.
- TV Stand: Shared remote.

Office (Hana):
- Desk: Hana’s charger, headphones, laptop, mug, pen, water bottle. Shared plant pot 3.

Storage:
- Floor: Shared vacuum cleaner.
- Shelf: Shared duster, gardening gloves, iron, toolbox.

Notes: No movements recorded on Day 0. Items remain in initial walkthrough locations. Hana’s office items stay at the desk during work hours. Dog items (leash, bowl, food, toy) are accessible for Yuki.
